text:
devin: quick check — smoke onboarding for `ursa-lite-3b` failed on config gate, looks like a weights host/checksum mismatch + tokenizer subtoken offset. pinging infra + gatekeepers.

maria: thanks, sending logs. I saw `tokenizer.decode` throwing an index error in the smoke runner. suspect vocab mismatch or pad_id shift.

devin: asset-bot reported checksum mismatch: expected `abc1234fa` got `def5678bc`. weights_uri in config is `gcs://redwood-models/ursa-lite/v1/weights/part-000` — can someone verify the upload?

asset-bot: Detected asset checksum mismatch for gcs://redwood-models/ursa-lite/v1/weights/part-000 — expected abc1234fa, actual def5678bc. Last modified 2024-11-10T16:04:12Z.

max: I can re-run the GCS copy job, but want to confirm the model manifest used by the gate. can you paste the relevant config.json snippet?

maria: here — minimal snippet from the manifest that failed gate:
```
{
  "model_name": "ursa-lite-3b",
  "weights_uri": "gcs://redwood-models/ursa-lite/v1/weights/part-000",
  "weights_checksum": "abc1234fa",
  "tokenizer": {
    "vocab_size": 50258,
    "pad_id": 1,
    "special_tokens": {"bos_id": 0, "eos_id": 2}
  },
  "serve_config": { "max_seq_len": 8192 }
}
```

ryan: interesting — our canonical tokenizer for `ursa-lite-3b` should have `vocab_size: 50257` and `pad_id: 0`. That +1 on both fields explains subtoken shift. Where did this manifest come from?

devin: it was generated by the onboarding script in the model repo (tag `v1-onboard`) — suspect manual edit to the tokenizer metadata before upload.

maria: quick mitigation: the gate can accept an override mapping for `pad_id` and `vocab_size` to allow smoke runs while we fix assets. but we should enforce strict schema for prod.

max: re-copy started: `gsutil -m cp gs://staging-uploads/ursa-lite/v1/* gs://redwood-models/ursa-lite/v1/weights/` — will verify checksums after. ETA ~6m.

devin: @ryan can you add a lint rule to the config-gate that validates `tokenizer.vocab_size` against `expected_vocab_size` and fails if mismatch? also a helpful error message to point to checksum failures.

ryan: yup — I'll add a quick rule. Proposed check list: 1) verify `weights_checksum` matches actual object checksum, 2) validate `tokenizer.vocab_size` matches model registry expected, 3) ensure `pad_id` ∈ [0, vocab_size-1]. I can push PR to config-lint in ~30m.

maria: one more note — if we allow overrides for smoke, add an explicit `smoke_allow_overrides` flag so we don't accidentally slip into prod.

devin: agreed. thanks all. I'll watch the copy job and re-run the smoke after checksums match. :thumbsup:

asset-bot: checksum verification completed: gcs://redwood-models/ursa-lite/v1/weights/part-000 now matches abc1234fa.

maria: re-ran smoke locally with the fixed weights + corrected tokenizer metadata -> smoke passes. pushing fix to the onboarding script to pin `pad_id: 0` and update manifest generation.

devin: closing loop — PRs: `onboard/ursa-lite-fix` (maria), `config-lint/tokenizer-checks` (ryan). will follow up in the gate PR for rollout scheduling.
